objective: Generate a FROST-authorized zkPI, price-limit proof, DvP product proof, non-negative reserve proofs, and recipient-scoped claim openings directly from seven node-local OCLOB MP-SPDZ Persistence slices, without reconstructing a complete Maker or Taker order in the proof coordinator, and verify the resulting public package before the existing Avalanche DeFMI finality path continues.
official_upstream_exception: MP-SPDZ compile.py is permitted only as the official compiler invoked through the Rust compiler adapter.

market.expected_maker_reserve_remainder: 20 securities units represented by a Pedersen commitment and threshold proof

proof_protocol.edge_binding: The participant edge signs Pedersen VSS commitments for price, reserve, and the unlinkable DeFMI settlement handle using the same generator suite as the DeFMI verifier.
proof_protocol.mpc_output: Each MP-SPDZ party writes one 616-field zkPI and DvP witness slice for every fixed fill slot; its OCLOB node retains only its own share under an owner-only path.
proof_protocol.transport: A dedicated mutual-TLS proof RPC lets the coordinator relay only public commitments, transcript seals, challenges, responses, and encrypted recipient-scoped openings.
proof_protocol.authorization: Three of seven durable FROST shares authorize the exact zkPI only after each selected node verifies the locally loaded quote digest, range statements, handles, and deadline.
proof_protocol.verification: The coordinator and DeFMI library verify the threshold amount and price ranges, signed Taker limit, amount-times-price relation, reserve remainders, Maker pool remainder, asset commitment, and recipient-bound opening envelopes.
proof_protocol.privacy_boundary: No proof RPC accepts or returns a raw Shamir share; the coordinator does not reconstruct the matched price, quantity, reserve opening, handle secret, or any commitment blinding while generating the proof.

required: the official MP-SPDZ compiler accepts the exact Rust-generated matching and proof circuit
all seven proof nodes load their own exact fill-slot Persistence slice
all public statements interpolate from seven evaluations and all proof rounds use an explicit three-node quorum
the Maker handle, Taker limit, Maker reserve, and Taker reserve match the signed participant-edge manifest commitments
the threshold-FROST zkPI verifies under the jointly generated public key
the public DvP product and three non-negative remainder proofs verify
all four opening envelopes are encrypted to the instruction-derived recipient and validate without revealing an opening to the coordinator
the verifier-complete threshold DvP package builds without any scalar price, quantity, reserve, balance, or blinding input
the existing five-validator Avalanche DeFMI path still reaches finality, rejects replay, and recovers its root after restart
reject_if: the contract digest differs from the preregistered manifest
any proof node reads another party's Persistence file or the extracted wire count is not exactly 616
a raw Shamir share or a scalar opening crosses the proof RPC
a manifest commitment differs from the MPC-derived proof statement
FROST, range, limit, product, remainder, asset, or opening-envelope verification fails
the public artifact exposes a private order field, secret share, local Persistence path, handle secret, reserve value, or blinding
Avalanche validator roots diverge, replay is accepted, or restart recovery fails
the artifact claims independent-operator, WAN, account-free-note, HSM, or removal of the legacy clear-balance compatibility projection

non_claims: Seven MPC containers and five AvalancheGo validators on one host are not independent-operator or WAN evidence.

This gate proves collaborative proof construction and verification; the existing clear-balance compatibility projection still opens one-order capabilities for its legacy reservation and portfolio update model.
Canonical DeFMI state still uses commitment accounts and a reservation root rather than account-free product notes.
Transition, approval, and laboratory identities are not HSM-backed operator custody.
One functional scenario is not throughput, adversarial-load, or economic-effect evidence.
